verdict.rationale: Greptile's own docs cover the core of this story. You can create custom rules for team-specific issues, upload style guides, and set repo-specific standards and custom context in greptile.json. It also imports existing rule files (Claude.md, AGENTS.md, cursor.rules), lets you scope rules to the directories each team owns, and lets you create patterns via MCP. missing for 10: evidence of AST/structural pattern rules, detail on rule syntax and how strictly rules are enforced, independent or hands-on corroboration that custom rules are actually enforced in reviews.
